# Demand for return of the agreed retention

To: ⟦PERSON|Eilís O'MacRell⟧, accounts contact

For ⟦ORG|Clover Spire Exhibitions Ltd⟧ (the 'Customer')

We act for ⟦PERSON|Márton McQuern⟧ in relation to the unpaid retention on the completed display installation. The signed inspection sheet records acceptance of the installation subject to replacement of one loose hinge. Our client replaced that hinge and supplied the dated completion photograph before the retention became payable.

Please arrange payment of EUR 510 within fourteen days or explain the contractual basis for continued retention. If a defect remains alleged, identify its location and provide the inspection material relied upon. A general reference to an unresolved snagging list does not identify an outstanding item where the only recorded defect has been remedied.

Our client's contact number for arranging an inspection is ⟦PHONE|+353 1 555 0186 x77⟧. Written correspondence should be sent to ⟦EMAIL|marton.retention@clover-quern.invalid⟧.

The demand excludes any charge for the later colour-change request. Our client has preserved the original inspection sheet and is willing to provide a copy with the replacement photograph.

Yours faithfully,

⟦PERSON|Nerisa MacVenn⟧, solicitor-advocate

Dated 31 December 2026. Paragraph 8.4 governs release of the retention.
